summary: Frontend-only verification of two new features on zebick site: (A) Blog related posts and (B) DSGVO consent checkbox on contact form. All requested items pass, EXCEPT the 'Neue Anfrage stellen' button on the contact success screen is blocked by a full-page '.hero-bg' overlay (pointer-events intercepted). Reset logic itself works correctly (verified via JS click).

action_items: Fix .hero-bg overlay on ContactPage: add CSS 'pointer-events: none' to the decorative hero-bg element (or lower its z-index) so the 'Neue Anfrage stellen' button (and any other content in the success screen) is clickable via mouse.
critical_code_review_comments: ContactPage: '.hero-bg' decorative background layer likely covers the success-screen 'Neue Anfrage stellen' button because it is positioned absolutely on top of subsequent content without pointer-events:none. Verify z-index and pointer-events on all pages that use hero-bg (also potentially affects other CTA buttons in hero sections).
BlogPostPage: navigation to new related post works but scroll-to-top is fine; ensure window.scrollTo({top:0}) runs on slug change (currently at scrollY=0 after nav — good).
Consider adding data-testid='contact-success' and data-testid='contact-reset-button' for cleaner test targeting.

context_for_next_testing_agent:
All feature acceptance criteria in review_request are met functionally. Only issue: on /kontakt success screen, .hero-bg overlay intercepts pointer events on 'Neue Anfrage stellen' button (Playwright saw '
…
intercepts pointer events'). Reset logic itself is correct (form clears, consent resets to unchecked) — verified via JS-triggered click. Fix likely in ContactPage.jsx or associated CSS: add pointer-events:none to .hero-bg, or ensure success-screen container has higher z-index. After fix, verify with normal .click() (no force=True).
rca of the issue: The .hero-bg decorative background element on /kontakt is rendered above interactive content in the stacking context (or lacks pointer-events:none). When the success screen (Vielen Dank!) replaces the form, the 'Neue Anfrage stellen' button lies within/behind the .hero-bg region. Since .hero-bg does not set pointer-events:none, all pointer events on the button area are absorbed by .hero-bg. Reproduction: submit contact form successfully, attempt to click 'Neue Anfrage stellen' via normal mouse click → click times out because .hero-bg intercepts events. Mitigation: add `pointer-events: none;` to the .hero-bg CSS rule (safe since it is purely decorative), or ensure success-screen wrapper has position:relative with a higher z-index than .hero-bg.
